injects.incident: US-23 Is Held At The Norton Interchange And The Dialysis Runs Are Queuing
injects.description: Since six this morning a crowd has held US-23 at the Norton interchange, the coalfields' only truck route, and the relief that was already late — an Abingdon warehouse that never got an order and six coalfield stores out of staples, a third of the stations dry, the dialysis and pharmacy runs — is now queuing on both sides (I303, I305, I318). A lane can be opened at set hours under VDOT signage and agreed with the people holding the road: supplies move, nobody is cleared, and it holds only while they still agree to it. A signed detour and closure plan puts the region an hour around through Norton and Coeburn and leaves US-23 shut. Someone has to decide which of those happens today.

injects.incident: Two Hundred Armed Volunteers Are Inside The Distribution Cages And The County Has Asked For Soldiers Instead
injects.description: Armed men calling themselves protection are standing inside the food and fuel distribution sites, and the county that voted last night to set its own distribution rules whatever Richmond says has asked the state for soldiers rather than deputies (I404). Posting Guard members at the sites under a written order that fixes whether they carry arms opens the queues and turns every photograph of a food line into a photograph of soldiers. Putting Guard vehicles on the supply convoys gets the freight through and leaves the cages, and the queue inside them, exactly as they are.
visible_to: Virginia National Guard, Southwest Task Force

injects.incident: The Nurses Are Being Followed On Rural Visits And Two Clinics Have Cut Their Runs
injects.description: Nurses doing rural visits are being followed from the hollows since the pharmacy queue turned into insulin, methadone and nobody able to verify a prescription (I309), and two coalfield clinics have cut their runs rather than send staff out alone. Paired visits, a deputy on call and a hotline for anyone followed keeps the visits happening, slower and fewer. Pulling staff in from Roanoke covers the shortfall and arrives, in a region that believes the state saved Roanoke and Bristol first, as proof of it.

injects.incident: Wise County Has Voted To Set Its Own Distribution Rules And Three Counties Are Watching
injects.description: The Board voted last night to set Wise County's own emergency distribution rules whatever Richmond says — who is served first, how much, at which sites — with Buchanan and Dickenson watching to see whether the county that defied the state gets served and the county that waited does not. Publishing the rules and running the county's sites under them is local authority exercised in the open, and it is defiance of the state if nobody agreed to it. A moderated county forum with ground rules and a speakers' list gives the grievance a hearing and serves nobody a bag of food.

injects.incident: Four Agencies Are Saying Four Things And The Region Believes None Of Them
injects.description: State, county, EMA and the utilities are each publishing their own account at their own hour, and after a week in which the only large discretionary money was held by an office nobody believed (I310) and four thousand claims sat against a fraud file (I316), the coalfields have stopped reading any of it. One update on a fixed schedule, with everyone on it saying the same thing at the same hour, is the fastest cure and only works if the others show up. A single emergency broadcast reaches phones and radios the feeds never touch, and a broadcast that turns out wrong is the next rumour.

injects.incident: The Sheriff Can Have US-23 Open By Noon And It Will Be On Camera
injects.description: The crowd at the Norton interchange is the only thing between the coalfields and their trucks, and the Coalition can remove it in ten minutes with Guard support if the Liaison asks (I401). Deputies clear the road and the food, fuel and dialysis runs move today, with arrests on camera and a crowd that leaves angrier and comes back somewhere else. Agreeing a lane with the people holding the road keeps the supplies moving, keeps the road closed, and holds exactly as long as the protest agrees to it. Legal observers will be watching either way.

injects.incident: The Men At The Cages Say They Are The Coalition's And The Coalition Has Not Said Otherwise
injects.description: The armed men inside the distribution sites are from the hollows and say they are the community's protection, and the coalition and the pastors are the only people whose public request would move them. Every hour they stay is an hour the county can point at the road and ask for soldiers instead (I402). The coalition can ask them to stand down and risk the ask failing in public, or it can publish its demands and name the people authorised to negotiate, which gives every official a party to talk to and leaves the men in the cages.
visible_to: Virginia National Guard, Southwest Task Force

injects.incident: The State Claims Authority In Three Counties That Claimed It Last Night
injects.description: Three counties have stopped waiting for Richmond and one of them has written its own distribution rules (I404). The Governor's office holds the thing that ends the fight over authority: a compact saying who decides distribution in Wise County — the county's rules where they are published and fair, the state's where they are not, and a joint table for disputes. Signing costs the state the appearance of control and gives three counties a reason to publish anything. Sending a Guard activation request puts soldiers in the coalfields to do whatever they are told, which is a deployment and not an agreement about who eats.

injects.incident: The Clip Is At Two Million Views And No One Has Said Whether It Is Him
injects.description: An unverified clip of the Governor's Liaison saying the coalfields can wait is at two million views and has become the coalfields' account of why the state saved Roanoke and Bristol first (I310). A forensic check and a documented takedown request gives every county official a finding to cite, and the platforms decide what they do with it. A verification desk that checks clips and claims within the hour beats a rumour only if it is faster than the rumour, and this one is three hours old.

injects.incident: Every Complaint About Who Was Served Has Nowhere To Go
injects.description: The grievance that the state served Roanoke and Bristol first has been a rumour for three days and now has names, addresses and an hour of queue behind it, and there is no counter taking it. Intake with a published tracker turns anger into cases that can be answered, and a tracker nobody updates is proof of the grievance. A mediated table brings the coalition, the county and the state into one room with an agreed agenda and answers nobody's complaint about the bag of food they did not get.

injects.incident: The Hollows Believe Their Pastor And No Feed Reaches Them
injects.description: Cell and internet are thin in the hollows and three days of contradictory statements from four agencies (I405) have left the church, the fire chief and the store owner as the only sources anyone there trusts. Pastors and fire chiefs carrying one verified update door to door reaches households no feed has ever reached, and is only as good as the update they carry. An hour of broadcast airtime with coalition speakers, officials and clergy on one stage gets the protest's case heard somewhere other than the road, in front of the people already watching.

injects.incident: The County's Rules Turn People Away And Nobody Is Writing Down Who
injects.description: Wise County's emergency distribution rules are turning households away at sites that deputies are also keeping quiet, so what was a rumour about favouritism is now a published rule somebody can point at (I404). Trained observers in visible vests at the blockade and the sites put enforcement and refusals on an independent record today and change nothing about who is served. An equal-service audit against the sites' own records answers the favouritism claim with evidence either way and spends the hour you have.
visible_to: Virginia National Guard, Southwest Task Force

injects.incident: The Lane Is Working And The People Holding US-23 Want It Made Permanent
injects.description: The convoy lane is running at the published hours and the dialysis, fuel and food runs are crossing it; the coalition now wants the lane made permanent and widened, the state wants US-23 fully open, and the people who agreed to the lane are the same people who would have to accept either. Widening it moves more of the region's traffic and hands control of the road to a group the state has not recognised. Fixing it at the published hours keeps the agreement intact and leaves every other car in the coalfields on the detour.

injects.incident: The Sites Are Open Behind Soldiers And The County Wants Them Gone By Friday
injects.description: The queues are moving behind a written order and the county that asked for troops now wants them off its sites before the weekend, because the photographs are exactly what it feared. A staged handover to the county's own deputies keeps the sites open and leaves the same cages to the same volunteers. Holding the posts keeps the queues moving and makes the Guard the permanent face of food distribution in Wise County.
visible_to: Virginia National Guard, Southwest Task Force

injects.incident: The Runs Are Back On The Road And The Threat Has Moved To The Sites
injects.description: Paired visits and an on-call deputy have rural care moving again; the same households now queue at distribution sites where armed men are standing inside the cages (I407), and the clinics that send staff to those sites are sending them into the one place on the route nobody has made safe. Moving clinical outreach out of the cages and into the churches and fire halls keeps staff safe and leaves the sickest households to walk further. Staffing the sites keeps care where the people are and puts clinicians in the same photograph as the volunteers.

injects.incident: Wise County's Rules Worked And Two Counties Want The Same Ordinance Today
injects.description: The county's published rules are being used at its sites and the queue is orderly, and Buchanan and Dickenson want the same ordinance on the same day — which makes Wise County the region's rule-maker and the state's problem, and puts three counties' distribution under rules nobody agreed to together. A joint table that harmonises the three keeps the county in charge and takes a day it may not have. Adopting the same ordinance county by county is instant and hands the state its proof that the region has stopped waiting for Richmond.

injects.incident: One Voice Works And Three Counties Want Their Own Part Of It
injects.description: The fixed schedule is holding and the same sentence goes out at the same hour, and the counties that publish their own distribution rules want their part of the update to say so — which is the difference between one region speaking and three counties using a state feed for their own announcement. Keeping the schedule whole holds the only thing the coalfields have started to believe. Giving each county its slot is honest about who decides and hands three local fights the state's microphone.

injects.incident: US-23 Is Open And The Crowd Is At The Distribution Sites
injects.description: The road is clear and the supply runs are moving; the crowd did not disperse, it walked to the distribution sites, where two hundred armed volunteers are already inside the cages and the county's own rules decide who is served. Deputies at the sites keep the queues orderly and put the same enforcement that cleared the road into the food line. Handing the queues to the community's own marshals keeps deputies off the cameras and leaves armed men deciding who eats.

injects.incident: The Armed Men Left And Nobody Is Inside The Cages
injects.description: The volunteers stood down on the coalition's request and the sites have nobody between the queue and the load, at the hour when the county's own rules are deciding who is served and deputies are the only people on site. The coalition's own named, unarmed marshals keep the queue orderly and put the community's people inside cages the state has already photographed. Leaving the sites to the county keeps the coalition out of the distribution fight and leaves its households' grievance with nobody's hands on it.

injects.incident: The Compact Is Signed And Two Counties Say It Gives Them Nothing
injects.description: The compact is signed and operating, and Buchanan and Dickenson — which watched Wise County claim its own rules — say an agreement between Richmond and Wise gives them a table they are not at. Extending the compact's table to all three settles who decides everywhere and makes the state responsible for three counties' distribution. Holding it to Wise keeps the agreement the state can actually deliver and leaves the two counties to write the same ordinance Wise just wrote.

injects.incident: The Clip Is Labelled And A Second One Is Already Up
injects.description: The forensic finding is out, the platforms labelled the first clip, and a second clip — the Liaison again, a different sentence — is up and moving on the same feeds. Checking the second one the same way keeps the desk's record intact and spends the hour the newsroom does not have. Publishing what is known about the pattern, who is making them and why, gets ahead of the third clip and publishes a story the newsroom cannot yet prove.

injects.incident: The Tracker Has Two Thousand Entries And Half Of Them Are The Same Family
injects.description: The tracker is answering complaints and the count has climbed past two thousand entries from a region of three hundred thousand, because the household that missed the fuel delivery, the pharmacy run and the food site filed three times and the counties cannot tell one problem from three. Deduplicating and publishing by household gives the region a number it can argue with and loses the record of who complained about what. Publishing everything as filed keeps every complaint visible and turns the tracker into evidence that the grievance is not being answered.

injects.incident: The Pastors Reached The Hollows And The Update They Carried Changed Overnight
injects.description: The messengers delivered and the hollows are working from an update that has since changed — the counties set their own distribution rules overnight (I404) and the sites are serving different households this afternoon. Carrying the new version on the same routes keeps the network trusted and puts the correction in the same hands that carried the wrong one. Waiting for the schedule and the rules to settle keeps the church out of a fight it did not start and leaves the hollows acting on yesterday's rules.

injects.incident: The Observers Are On The Record And The County Says The Line Was Crossed
injects.description: The observers' log exists, it records who was turned away and how enforcement was applied, and the county says the observers were inside a secured site and their presence is why a queue stopped. Publishing the log answers the favouritism claim with an independent record and makes the observers the story. Withdrawing them from the sites keeps the access the county can still revoke and leaves every refusal at that door unwitnessed.

injects.incident: The Road Held Through Its Deadline And The Detour Is Now The Only Road
injects.description: US-23 was still held when the lane deadline passed, the detour is in practice the region's only route, and the dialysis runs are going an hour the long way through Coeburn while a third of the stations are dry (I305). Deputies can open the road under a published order with the enforcement documented, which moves everything today and makes the arrest footage the region's next story. A lane agreed at set hours moves the medical and fuel runs and leaves the road itself held for another day.

injects.incident: The Road Was Cleared And The Crowd Has Re-formed At Coeburn
injects.description: Enforcement cleared the Norton interchange and the crowd re-formed at the Coeburn fuel stops within the hour, and the cameras that were on the first clearance are now on the second site — with the fuel, food and dialysis runs routed an extra hour while a third of the stations are dry (I305). A signed detour and closure plan moves traffic around the second site on published signs, and traffic tolerates it only for as long as the road is closed. A second enforcement clears somewhere else and moves the crowd again.

injects.incident: The Volunteers Are Still Inside The Cages And A Deputy Has Been Photographed With Them
injects.description: The coalition never asked, the armed men are still inside the cages, and a deputy has now been photographed standing with them at a site where the county's own rules decide who is served. The pastors' and the coalition's public request is still the only thing that has ever moved these men, and it costs nothing but the risk of failing in public. The Guard posting at the sites puts soldiers inside the cages and leaves the volunteers in the same photograph.

injects.incident: A Nurse Was Followed Home And Two Clinics Have Stopped Visiting Entirely
injects.description: The pairing never happened, a nurse was followed to her door, and the two remaining coalfield clinics have stopped rural visiting — so the households an hour from the nearest open store (I304), the ones the pharmacies cannot verify scripts for (I309), are now an hour from a clinician too. Paired visits, a deputy on call and a documented hotline put the runs back on the road in the same hour. Bringing staff in from Roanoke keeps the clinic doors open and sends city staff out alone on the same roads.

injects.incident: Three Counties Are Writing Their Own Rules And The State Says It Will Fund None Of Them
injects.description: The deadline passed with Wise County acting alone and Buchanan and Dickenson copying the ordinance, so three counties are distributing under three sets of rules the state has not agreed to and the state has said it will fund none of them. A compact signed now gives three counties a published basis for their rules and the state a table for the disputes. A broadcast telling the coalfields what the state will and will not fund binds nobody to anything and adds a fourth account to a region that has stopped reading.
injects.location: Wise, Buchanan and Dickenson counties / Richmond
